description: This file defines the Termynal class, a JavaScript component for creating animated terminal-like interfaces with features like typing animation, progress bars, and controls for restart and fast-forward. It includes methods for initializing, loading lines, and handling animations, and it automatically initializes if specified via script attributes.

classes.name: Termynal
classes.description: A class for creating animated terminal window widgets with typing and progress animations.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Termynal widget with container and options.

methods.name: loadLines
methods.description: Loads and prepares all terminal lines for animation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the widget, clears container, and starts animation.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the animation sequence, rendering lines based on their data attributes.

methods.name: addRestart
methods.description: Adds restart control to the container.

methods.name: addFinish
methods.description: Adds fast-forward control to the container.

methods.name: lineDataToElements
methods.description: Converts line data objects into DOM elements.

methods.name: _attributes
methods.description: Generates attribute string for line data objects.
